_doc: PROMPT.md rule 1: vector only for light, glow, particles, masks, cast shadows, the edge vignette and UI. Per file, the react-native-svg drawing components allowed. Anything else drawing in components/village/iso or app/dev-iso.tsx is reported by `loupe_checks.py vector-code`. Files absent here (Fierte, EnsembleVocation, Rempart, Statue, Retouches, FeuxDessines, CorbeauxToits, petitsDetails) draw decor in vector and must fail until painted; IsoCarteDemo Path/Polygon/Text and RuesDessinees Path and Chantier Path/Polygon likewise. Review before trusting: written from reading file headers, not from rendering.

components/village/iso/AmbianceCarte.tsx.why: light of the map, night pools, the day veil on the surroundings

components/village/iso/Alentours.tsx.why: cast shadows of the forest masses, one soft ellipse each in a single Svg

components/village/iso/MotifsSol.tsx.why: fills a tile with a painted Pattern image (mask carrier, draws no vector shape of its own)

components/village/iso/Chantier.tsx.why: dust (particles); Path and Polygon are scaffold or ground, so they fail
